name: A classifier of your own
what: You add a program of your own, such as a script, a small model or your own agent, and it gives opinions about the computers its grant names. It reads their facts and reports, the opinions about them, and whether each is running, paused or stopped, and each opinion it gives points at the lines that led to it. Being code, it runs in a computer, it cannot act on any computer, and what it spends is your choice.
